tools.name: transcribe_video
tools.description: Submit a video URL for transcription and wait for the result. Supports Instagram Reels/Posts, TikTok videos, YouTube videos/Shorts, Facebook videos/Reels, and video posts on Threads, LinkedIn, X and Bluesky. New jobs cost 1 credit. Existing matching transcripts may be reused without another charge. There is no storage quota.

url.description: Video URL (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Threads, LinkedIn, X or Bluesky)

includeComments.description: Also extract top comments for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, with pinned/creator comments first where available; not the full thread. Defaults to false. Facebook is unsupported. Total cost remains 1 credit; existing transcripts are reused without new comment extraction.

tools.name: get_transcription
tools.description: Get a transcription by its ID or requestId. Returns the full transcription text and any extracted comments when completed, or status/error info if still processing or failed.

tools.name: list_transcriptions
tools.description: List ONE PAGE of your transcriptions, newest first (default 20, max 200). The API does not report a library total. `hasMore` and `nextCursor` describe pagination; `cursor` selects a subsequent page. `libraryTotal` is populated only for a complete first-page result. Transcripts are returned as previews. `owner` and `topic` combine. With either one a page can be short or empty while `hasMore` is true, so keep following `nextCursor` before saying nothing matched. Only reels sorted on the user's Reel Board have a topic: the rest show null and never match a topic filter.

owner.description: Creator handle or display name. Capitals, spaces and @ are ignored; the rest must match the whole name.

topic.description: Reel Board topic: money (Money & Finance), food (Food & Recipes), business (Business & Growth), fitness (Health & Fitness), tech (Tech & AI), self (Self-improvement), howto (How-to & Learning), travel, style (Style & Beauty), home, fun (Entertainment), other

subTopic.description: Sub-topic inside `topic`, such as Investing or AI Tools. Needs `topic`. An unknown name returns an error listing the valid ones.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from a previous call, to fetch the following page

tools.name: search_transcriptions
tools.description: Find transcriptions whose original video URL contains the given string. Returns the newest match in full, plus ids of any other matches. Useful for checking whether a video has already been transcribed. The search covers a bounded window of your most recent transcriptions and returns a capped number of matches, so `found: false` means "not found in that window" — it does not prove the video was never transcribed, and `matchesReturned` is not a library-wide count.

url.description: The video URL to search for

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Check your ReelScribe credit balance, subscription tier, how many completed transcriptions are stored, and how long they are kept. Each transcription costs 1 credit. There is no storage quota — a library is bounded by time (see `retention`), not by a count limit. `library.completedTranscriptions` is a bounded count: when `library.isCapped` is true the real number is higher than the returned count.

tools.name: validate_url
tools.description: Check if a URL is a supported video platform (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Threads, LinkedIn, X, Bluesky) without submitting for transcription. Returns the detected platform and normalized URL.

tools.name: transcribe_bulk
tools.description: Submit up to 1,000 video URLs as a batch. The account tier sets the actual batch limit; each new video costs 1 credit. Existing transcripts are reused. Returns a bulk job ID. Requires an API key or additional batch transcription consent.

tools.name: transcribe_instagram_channel
tools.description:
Transcribe up to 50 reels from an Instagram channel. Paid plans only. Reserves 1 credit per requested reel under the same refund rules as the website, so only reels actually transcribed are charged. Requires an API key or additional batch transcription consent.

Without direction it takes the channel's newest reels, optionally after a date. It cannot reach past those, so asking twice finds nothing new.

Use direction when the user wants more from a channel they have already started, such as "5 more" or "the next ones". direction: "older" continues back through reels they do not have yet. direction: "newer" fetches reels posted since their most recent one, oldest of those first if there are more than requested. If the user did not say which they want, ask them before calling: older reels, or new posts since last time. Take the channel from the conversation; past channel jobs also record channelUsername.

The reply can report fewer reels than requested, or status "nothing_found" with no job. Tell the user. If it includes nextCursor, the search ran out of time, so call again with that cursor and the remaining count.

direction.description: Continue a channel the user has already started

cursor.description: nextCursor from a previous older request

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List one page of batch/channel jobs or read progress for a specific bulk job ID. Results belong to the connected account.
